svg.text: The best energies at each cost, instance by instance
Every energy whose paper, or QMBL's own run, states what it cost in hours, on the 9 instances with at least two such rows.
Colour is the kind of number; filled marks can hold a record, hollow ones cannot.
record: −0.497694 (CNN-MPS), no cost stated, not drawn
exact: −0.560373 (ED), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.766230 (ACE), no cost stated, not drawn
exact: −0.503810 (ED), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.496914 (CNN-MPS), no cost stated, not drawn
record: −0.496799 (CNN-MPS (h = 32, l = 20)), no cost stated, not drawn
Circles are GPU-hours, squares CPU core-hours (8 rows). For 13 rows the hours are devices × wall-clock, multiplied here. Labels marked QMBL
are QMBL's own reference runs; each instance's own figure names all of them.
